albumTitle: ZBook 14" Copilot+ PC Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 9 PRO HX 375 with 32GB Memory - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Pro-level performance combines with true mobility in this sleek and powerful laptop. Review 3D designs, create with AI tools in pro apps, run Copilot locally and work on multiple projects anywhere. Stay productive with an AI PC mobile workstation that delivers power efficiency and long-lasting battery. Say goodbye to lags and crashes with fast responsiveness on projects. With an AMD Ryzen AI 9 PRO HX processor and large memory configuration, open large files and run pro apps simultaneously for speedy multitasking and increased productivity. Hardware AI accelerators deliver power to propel advanced workloads. Offload and run productivity tasks locally up to 50 TOPS NPU while also multi-tasking across AI accelerated professional applications. The most mobile ZBook, now redesigned, is made to move. With a long-lasting battery this sleek device is small enough to fit in your bag so you can stay productive anywhere. This is high performance workstation power on the go. HP cares about the impact our products have on our people, communities, and the planet. That’s why this device is EPEAT Gold registered and the outer box packaging is 100% sustainably sourced.

longDescription: Experience unparalleled productivity and efficiency with the HP EliteBook 8 G1i 14-inch Next Gen AI PC. Designed for strategic work, offering seamless multitasking and unique collaboration features. Accomplish more, faster than ever, with AI that maintains momentum, offloads tasks, and analyzes data like never before. Free up time to focus on what matters with the latest Intel Core Ultra processor with a 48 TOPS NPU. Work anywhere without compromising on performance with Windows 11 and HP collaboration, security, and connectivity technology. Summarize and rewrite content, get relevant content recommendations, and stay organized with Microsoft Copilot. Express yourself in almost any light using the ultra-bright outdoor viewable touch display with anti-glare and ambient light sensors. Get more done in between charges with battery life that is efficiently managed by next-gen AI. The portability of your PC and the reliability of a fast connection determines where you can work. Get a fast and reliable connection in dense wireless environments with gigabit data rate Wi-Fi 7.

longDescription: Boost efficiency and let users discover new possibilities with the HP EliteBook 6 G1a Next Gen AI PC. Cutting-edge AI experiences paired with highly secure and easily managed setups make this device ideal for seamless integration into demanding IT environments. Develop innovative ideas with the lightning-fast AMD Ryzen processor with an up to 50 TOPS NPU. Summarize and rewrite content, get relevant recommendations, and stay organized with Microsoft Copilot. Get more done with battery life outlasts the workday and is efficiently managed by next-gen AI. Express yourself in almost any light using the ultra-bright outdoor viewable touch display with anti-glare and ambient light sensors. The portability of your PC and the reliability of a fast connection determines where you can work. Get a fast and reliable connection in dense wireless environments with gigabit data rate Wi-Fi 7.

longDescription: Experience unparalleled productivity and efficiency with the HP EliteBook 8 G1i 14-inch Next Gen AI PC. Designed for strategic work, offering seamless multitasking and unique collaboration features. Accomplish more, faster than ever, with AI that maintains momentum, offloads tasks, and analyzes data like never before. Free up time to focus on what matters with the latest Intel Core Ultra processor with a 48 TOPS NPU. Work anywhere without compromising on performance with Windows 11 and HP collaboration, security, and connectivity technology. Summarize and rewrite content, get relevant content recommendations, and stay organized with Microsoft Copilot. Express yourself in almost any light using the ultra-bright outdoor viewable touch display with anti-glare and ambient light sensors. Get more done in between charges with battery life that is efficiently managed by next-gen AI. The portability of your PC and the reliability of a fast connection determines where you can work. Get a fast and reliable connection in dense wireless environments with gigabit data rate Wi-Fi 7.

albumTitle: OmniStudio X 31.5 inch All-in-One Desktop 32-c0010 Intel Core Ultra 7 155H 16GB RAM 2TB SSD Win 11 Home
longDescription: Works with you, for you, for more productivity: Designed with cutting-edge technology tailored to your needs and a powerful Intel Core Ultra processor with Intel AI Boost, this adaptable HP OmniStudio X All-in-One works for you. Stay in the zone on your most demanding tasks wherever your creativity takes you without interruptions thanks to powerful features and faster speeds. Connect your digital worlds in one powerful hub using the USB Type-C with DisplayPort-In, and pick up wherever you left off using the camera, speakers and keyboard. Kickstart your creativity and productivity with Copilot in Windows, your AI-powered intelligent assistant.Ultimate entertainment. Genuine connections. Uninterrupted impact. Seamlessly transition from work to play and dive into cinema quality audio and immersive visuals with the 4K IMAX enhanced display. Every call is an opportunity to showcase your ideas to the world through a pop-up 5MP camera with a manual shutter ensuring your privacy is always protected. Your connections are more meaningful thanks to Windows Studio Effects, including automatic framing, background blur, voice focus and the ability to maintain eye contact. Immersive visuals and genuine connections without interruptions and less distractions, all in one device. Designed with you and your wellbeing in mind: Harmonize your creative pursuits with built in AI-powered wellness features. Get through the day with less eye discomfort with a screen distance reminder that gently blurs the screen when you're too close. Take control of your screen time with a screen time reminder that encourages healthy viewing habits. Have the ultimate setup tailored to your needs with the height adjustable stand packed with plenty of ports, keeping your workflow seamless and uninterrupted.  Built for a better tomorrow: The HP OmniStudio X All-in-One is designed using up to 25% recycled metals and 35% post-consumer recycled plastics. EPEAT Gold with Climate+ and ENERGY STAR certifications demonstrate reduced environmental impact and increased energy efficiency.

longDescription: ASUS V500SVC packs everyday performance, dependable security, and easy expansion into a slim 3.66″-wide small-form-factor chassis—perfect for tidy desks at home, school, or the office. Powered by Windows 11 Home and an Intel® Core™ i5-13420H, it stays smooth with 8GB DDR5 and a fast 512GB PCIe® 4.0 SSD, while Intel® UHD Graphics deliver crisp 4K streaming and presentations. longDescription: Designed for business professionals, the Lenovo 14" ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 Multi-Touch Laptop delivers robust performance. Housing a 3.3 GHz AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840U 8-Core processor, the ThinkPad T14 Gen 5 can juggle multiple applications, navigate resource-intensive software, and even run virtual machines with ease. And with support for up to 64GB of DDR5 RAM, this laptop can provide increased bandwidth and reduce power consumption compared to previous generations. Experience faster data processing and overall smoother performance.

And with support for up to 64GB of DDR5 RAM, this laptop can provide increased bandwidth and reduce power consumption compared to previous generations. albumTitle: MacBook Air 13" Certified Refurbished - Intel Core i5 - 8GB Memory - 256GB SSD (2017)
longDescription: This Refurbished MacBook Air is a Pre-Owned Macbook. At 13.3" in size, the 16:10 display features a screen resolution of 1440 x 900. It features a glossy finish and LED backlight technology for enhanced image quality and energy efficiency. The system is loaded with 256GB of flash storage rather than an old-fashioned hard drive. Flash storage doesn't just give you a lighter, thinner computer. It also allows for impressive battery life -- up to 12 hours of web browsing and 30 days of standby time. The computer is powered by a 1.8 GHz Intel Core i5 dual-core processor and has 8GB of 1600 MHz LPDDR3 RAM. Graphics are provided by integrated Intel HD Graphics 6000. The computer features all the amenities you expect on a Mac -- a 720p FaceTime HD webcam, dual-band 802.11ac Wi-Fi (also compatible with 802.11a/b/g/n), Bluetooth 4.0, and built-in stereo speakers.

longDescription: Ready to flip into boosted productivity? Meet the ultra-versatile, AI-powered ASUS Vivobook 16 Flip. Designed to streamline your workflow and transform the way you tackle tasks, it has a 360° hinge for maximum flexibility and supports ASUS Pen 2.0 (sold separately), adapting effortlessly to your needs. Equipped with the Intel Core Ultra 7 processor (Series 2) and an Intel AI Boost NPU, it also features a stunning 16-inch Lumina OLED NanoEdge touchscreen. With up to 22 hours of battery life3, it can power you through multiple working days. Ideal for students and professionals, this all-in-one device enhances your productivity like never before.

albumTitle: gram Book 15" Laptop - Intel Core i5-1334U with 8GB Memory - 512GB SSD
longDescription: The LG gram Book 15.6" laptop is designed to keep up with your fast-paced lifestyle, combining premium features with a slim, lightweight design that’s ready to go wherever your work or adventures take you. The Full HD (1920 x1 080) anti-glare IPS display delivers sharp visuals and crisp colors, perfect for viewing everything from work presentations to your favorite shows. Windows 11 Home with Copilot takes productivity to the next level, offering intelligent AI tools to help you write, organize, and streamline tasks with ease. Whether you’re drafting reports or managing your schedule, Copilot’s AI-powered assistance simplifies virtually everything and boosts efficiency. Powered by an Intel Core i5 (13th Gen: 1334U) processor and Intel Iris Xe Graphics, gram Book handles multitasking, streaming, and creative projects effortlessly. With 8GB of dual-channel DDR4 RAM and a 512GB Gen4 NVMe SSD, you’ll experience fast performance and plenty of space for files and applications—with room to expand. Gram Book's 51Wh battery keeps you powered for work and play, while the laptops's HD webcam’s built-in privacy shutter gives you control over your security. From productivity to entertainment, LG gram Book delivers everything you need in a streamlined, portable package.

albumTitle: TUF Gaming F16 16" 144Hz FHD+ Gaming Laptop - Intel Core 5 210H with 8GB Memory - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 - 512GB SSD
longDescription: The TUF F16 is built to dominate every gaming journey. Immerse yourself in Windows 11 Home, powered by a 13th Gen Intel Core 5 210H processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4050 laptop GPU featuring NVIDIA Advanced Optimus. Its classic design, enhanced by a stylish embossed TUF logo, offers understated elegance, while the FHD+ 144Hz display with 100% sRGB color delivers striking visuals that put you at the center of the action. Equipped with 8GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB PCIe Gen4 SSD, multitasking is effortless. Military-grade durability guarantees reliable performance wherever you play. The TUF Gaming F16 utilizes Arc Flow Fans, four exhaust vents, five dedicated heat pipes, and an anti-dust filter for optimal cooling efficiency and minimal noise. Boost your gaming immersion with Dolby Atmos and Hi-Res audio, making the TUF Gaming F16 your ultimate partner for high-performance, captivating gaming.

longDescription: Experience unparalleled gaming with the ROG Strix SCAR 18. Powered by the latest Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 laptop GPU, it delivers stunning performance. The advanced ROG Intelligent Cooling system, with a vapor chamber, sandwiched heatsink, Tri-fan design, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal, ensures peak performance under intense workloads. Enjoy breathtaking visuals on the 2.5K Nebula HDR Display with a 240Hz refresh rate and 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy, enhanced by a dual ACR anti-reflective coating. With tool-less access for easy upgrades and 3 months of PC Game Pass, this laptop is designed to elevate your game.

albumTitle: ROG Flow Z13 13.4" 2.5K 180Hz Touch-Screen Gaming Laptop - Copilot+ PC - AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 - 128GB RAM - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Powered by the AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395 processor, 16 Zen 5 CPU cores, and 128GB LPDDR5X quad-channel unified memory, the 2025 ROG Flow Z13 combines portability and power in a sleek 13-inch chassis. Its 2.5K ROG Nebula Display, featuring a 180Hz refresh rate, 100% DCI-P3 color coverage, and touchscreen capability, delivers stunning visuals for gaming and creative tasks. With a 170° adjustable kickstand, the new ROG Flow Z13 effortlessly transforms into a tablet for gaming and creativity on the go.

albumTitle: ROG Zephyrus G16 16" OLED 2.5K 240Hz Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9 - 64GB RAM - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 - 2TB SSD
longDescription: Experience the height of gaming innovation with the ROG Zephyrus G16. Featuring an all-new premium aluminum chassis with customizable lighting, this laptop merges style and durability. Its ultra-slim 0.59” profile and lightweight 4.30lbs 16” chassis redefines portability, but does not compromise on performance. Powered by Windows 11 Pro, Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 285H processor, and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 GPU, the Zephyrus G16 seamlessly aligns with your lifestyle, meeting all your gaming and creative demands. ROG Intelligent Cooling features liquid metal for reduced CPU temperatures and upgraded Arc Flow Fans for improved airflow to sustain peak performance on the Zephyrus G16 no matter the task. Immerse yourself in the OLED Nebula Display and enjoy rapid 0.2ms response times, vivid 2.5K resolution, and a smooth 240Hz refresh rate.

longDescription: Experience unparalleled gaming with the ROG Strix SCAR 16. Powered by the latest Intel Core Ultra 9 275HX processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 laptop GPU, it delivers stunning performance. The advanced ROG Intelligent Cooling system, with a vapor chamber, sandwiched heatsink, Tri-fan design, and Conductonaut Extreme liquid metal, ensures peak performance under intense workloads. Enjoy breathtaking visuals on the 2.5K Nebula HDR Display with a 240Hz refresh rate and 100% DCI-P3 color accuracy, enhanced by a dual ACR anti-reflective coating. With tool-less access for easy upgrades and 3 months of PC Game Pass, this laptop is designed to elevate your game.

longDescription: Unlock a next-level gaming experience with the ROG Strix G16. Featuring an ROG Nebula Display with 240Hz refresh rate, the ROG Strix delivers stunning visuals. Powered by an AMD Ryzen 9 9955HX3D Processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, enjoy seamless gaming and creative performance. With 32GB DDR5 RAM, a 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD, and advanced ROG Intelligent Cooling, stay at the top of your game. The esports-ready keyboard, Dolby Atmos audio, and customizable RGB Aura Light Bar elevate every moment. Plus, enjoy easy upgrades and 3 months of PC Game Pass for the ultimate gaming experience.

albumTitle: Galaxy Book5 Pro - Copilot+ PC - 16" 3K AMOLED Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 - 16GB Memory - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴  kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

albumTitle: Galaxy Book5 360 - Copilot+ PC - 15.6" FHD AMOLED Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 - 16GB Memory - 512GB SSD
longDescription: Go from class time to downtime on one versatile device. With a 2-in-1 design, Galaxy Book5 360 makes it easier to tackle all your tasks and connect seamlessly to your other Galaxy devices, bringing your world full circle. Boasting a brilliant 15.6" Full-HD AMOLED display and a 360-degree hinge, Book5 360 makes everything from studying to streaming a comfortable experience. Need to go laptop mode to finish an assignment? Easy. Want to take a break with a movie? Prop up Book5 360 in tent mode, select what you want to watch from your touchscreen and kick back. No matter how many hours you plan to spend prepping for your next test or cozying up to watch your favorite series, Book5 360 has a battery built to keep up for hours on end.* Whether you need structure or want to enjoy some spontaneity, Galaxy Book5 360 adapts to do exactly what you need it to, seamlessly.

longDescription: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴  kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

albumTitle: Galaxy Book5 Pro - Copilot+ PC - 16" 3K AMOLED Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 - 32GB Memory - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴  kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

albumTitle: Galaxy Book5 Pro - Copilot+ PC - 14" 3K AMOLED Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 7 - 32GB Memory - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Galaxy Book5 Pro gives you premium performance and pro-level power in a device designed to move as fast as you do. From creating presentations to editing large files, the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 7 processor makes it all feel unbelievably fast and smooth. With its lightweight build and long-lasting battery, you can seamlessly transition from your desk to a cafe to a client meeting without missing a beat. Packed with cutting-edge technology, Book5 Pro has smart features like AI Select¹ and Copilot AI assistance to help you simplify complex tasks and streamline your workflow. Because work rarely happens on just one device, Book5 Pro is also built with advanced features that make it easy to work in sync with the rest of your Galaxy devices. Get an important notification or need to respond to a text mid-project? Phone Link ² puts your phone screen right on Book5 Pro, allowing you to access all your important phone features and control it right from your PC. Sharing big files between your devices? With Quick Share³ you can do it wirelessly, quickly and safely. Plus, Auto Hotspot⁴  kicks in when your Wi-Fi doesn’t, so your laptop stays connected even when your day takes a detour. No matter where work takes you, Galaxy Book5 Pro keeps you a step ahead.

longDescription: Create anywhere, your way, with the Yoga 7 2-in-1. Its 360° convertible design and responsive touchscreen let you switch between tablet, tent, or laptop mode effortlessly. Add the optional Yoga Pen for smooth, precise control wherever inspiration strikes. Powered by a AMD Ryzen AI 7 350 processor and a 50 TOPS NPU, this Copilot+ PC is optimized by Lenovo’s AI Core to immaculately balance power and performance. The 14" PureSight OLED display, featuring a 60Hz refresh rate and Dolby Vision, delivers bold, vibrant colors that make your ideas pop.

albumTitle: Yoga 7 2-in-1 - Copilot+ PC - 14" 2K OLED Touchscreen Laptop - AMD Ryzen AI 5 340 - 16GB Memory - 512GB SSD
longDescription: Create anywhere, your way, with the Yoga 7 2-in-1. Its 360° convertible design and responsive touchscreen let you switch between tablet, tent, or laptop mode effortlessly. Add the optional Yoga Pen for smooth, precise control wherever inspiration strikes. Powered by a AMD Ryzen AI 5 340 processor and a 50 TOPS NPU, this Copilot+ PC is optimized by Lenovo’s AI Core to immaculately balance power and performance. The 14" PureSight OLED display, featuring a 60Hz refresh rate and Dolby Vision, delivers bold, vibrant colors that make your ideas pop.

albumTitle: Zenbook Duo Dual 14" 3K OLED Touch Laptop - Evo Intel Core Ultra 9 285H with 32GB RAM - Intel Arc Graphics - 1TB SSD
longDescription: Relax, you can DUO it. Introducing the ASUS Zenbook DUO — a revolutionary dual-screen laptop with two 14-inch OLED touchscreens, a detachable full-size Bluetooth magnetic keyboard that charges when attached and a built-in kickstand. Expertly combining multitasking versatility with superb mobility, the dual displays instantly expand your workspace up to 19.8 inches. Outstanding performance is assured with the AI-powered Intel Core Ultra 9 285H processor and 32GB LPDDR5x memory, plus 1 TB PCIe 4.0 SSD. Paired with dedicated smart software, intuitive gesture control and a 75Wh battery, the easy-to-use Zenbook DUO maximizes productivity with zero fuss.

albumTitle: ThinkPad E16 Gen 1 16" Touch-Screen Laptop - Intel Core i5 with 16GB Memory - 512GB SSD
longDescription: The entry-level ThinkPad, E Series features the famous keyboard and trackpoint, and is MIL-SPEC tested ensuring the build quality for which ThinkPad is renowned. Boosted with 13th Gen Intel Core processors and Windows 11 Pro OS, this ThinkPad E16 Gen 1 is a perfect fit for professionals looking for a powerful and versatile machine. The integrated Intel Iris XE graphics lets users multitask, stream videos and run basic games and business applications with ease. Hybrid professionals will appreciate the USB-C, HDMI and Thunderbolt 4 ports enabling quick transfer of design files and complex spreadsheets, and connection to external monitors. The 16" anti-glare display surface with 16:10 aspect ratio makes it easier to comfortably work in bright-light conditions providing extra screen real estate to reduce scrolling. Whether you’re making a video call or listening to music, enjoy crystal-clear sound and voice quality with the HD audio, Dolby Atmos stereo speakers, dual-array mics and FHD 1080p camera. A touch style fingerprint reader is integrated in the power button that authenticates user identity and prevents unauthorized entry into the system.
